subject.title: fix: forward response-frame meta to clients

question: Should OpenClaw accept optional top-level `res.meta` as an additive v4 Gateway response-envelope field, given that strict older generated clients may reject unknown response fields?
rationale: The implementation is the narrow bug fix, but the public protocol compatibility choice cannot be fully settled by tests or contributor proof.

options.title: Accept additive v4 `res.meta` after rebase
options.body: Resolve the dirty branch against current main and keep the optional schema, docs, Swift default, tests, and responder forwarding as the intended v4 behavior.

options.title: Require version-gated metadata
options.body: Pause this PR and ask for a protocol-versioned or payload-level metadata design if strict v4 envelope stability matters more than the narrow bug fix.

options.title: Defer the protocol change
options.body: Leave the linked issue open and defer response metadata until a broader Gateway protocol compatibility pass.

recommendation.title: Accept additive v4 `res.meta` after rebase
recommendation.body: Resolve the dirty branch against current main and keep the optional schema, docs, Swift default, tests, and responder forwarding as the intended v4 behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans Gateway runtime behavior and public protocol compatibility, and steipete has the clearest recent history across both surfaces.
